legend: Trida attached $$$n$$$ cables to $$$2n$$$ sockets arranged from left to right. Every cable has a label from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, and its two ends are attached to the two sockets carrying its label.

Two cables are tangled when their ends alternate along the row. In other words, cables $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ are tangled if the four relevant labels appear in the order $$$x,y,x,y$$$ or $$$y,x,y,x$$$, with other labels possibly between them.

Trida will remove exactly one entire cable, including both of its ends. Find all cables she can remove so that no two remaining cables are tangled. If zero or one cable remains after the removal, there is no tangled pair.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^5$$$), the number of cables.
The second line contains $$$2n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le n$$$). Every integer from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ occurs exactly twice.
output: On the first line, print the number $$$k$$$ of cables whose removal leaves no tangled pair.
On the second line, print their $$$k$$$ labels in increasing order. If $$$k=0$$$, print an empty second line.
note: In the sample, removing cable $$$2$$$ leaves the sequence $$$1,1,3,4,4,3$$$, which has no tangled pair. Removing any other cable leaves at least one tangled pair.

legend: Trida 将 $$$n$$$ 电缆连接到从左到右排列的 $$$2n$$$ 插座上。每根电缆都有一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的标签，其两端连接到带有其标签的两个插座上。
当两根电缆的两端沿行交替时，它们就会缠绕在一起。换句话说，如果四个相关标签以 $$$x,y,x,y$$$ 或 $$$y,x,y,x$$$ 的顺序出现，并且其中可能还夹杂着其他标签，那么 $$$x$$$ 和 $$$y$$$ 电缆就会缠绕在一起。
Trida 会精确地移除一根完整的电缆，包括其两端。找到所有她能移除的电缆，确保剩下的两根电缆不会纠缠在一起。如果移除后没有剩下零根或一根电缆，则不存在纠缠对。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^5$$$），即电缆数量。
第二行包含$$$2n$$$个整数$$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le n$$$）。从$$$1$$$到$$$n$$$的每一个整数恰好出现两次。
output: 在第一行打印出移除后没有缠结对的电缆数$$$k$$$。
在第二行，按递增顺序打印它们的$$$k$$$标签。如果$$$k=0$$$，打印空的第二行。
note: 在样本中，移除电缆 $$$2$$$ 会留下序列 $$$1,1,3,4,4,3$$$，它没有纠缠对。移除任何其他电缆会留下至少一个纠缠对。
